newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences Corp Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences Corp Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Results for fiscal 1997 include a special charge of $48.9 million related to the August 1, 1996 acquisition of The Continuum Co Inc. The charge, net of income taxes, is $35.3 million or $0.45 a share. During last year's quarter ended Dec. 29, 1995, $26 million of purchased research and development was expensed in connection with the acquisition by Continuum of SOCS Holding. The charge, which carried no tax deduction, is 34 cents per share. During last year's fourth quarter, a special charge of $50.1 million was expensed in connection with Continuum's acquisition of Hogan Systems. This charge, net of income taxes, is $35.7 million or 47 cents per share. All fiscal 1996 amounts have been restated to reflect the Continuum acquisition, which was accounted for as a pooling of interests.
